title: fix(multicursor): may exceed kitty cursors param limit
body:
Problem:
If there are >85 cursors on-screen, the terminal barfs the termcodes to the screen.

Solution:
Emit the coords in chunks. Only "0;4" clears, so the groups accumulate.



fix https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/41969
